title: Extend a Guardrail — Tighten a Confidence Floor
note: An overlay may RAISE a confidence floor, ADD a label, REMOVE a rung, RESTRICT privacy locality, REDUCE a quota, or upgrade a fail-open posture to fail-closed. It may never widen. Lowering a floor, adding a rung, relaxing privacy, and relaxing fail posture are each a distinct, separately-numbered load refusal — and they are refusals, not silent clamps, because a guardrail that quietly accepted a weakening would be worse than no guardrail at all: the operator would believe a gate was in place that had in fact been removed. The direction of the lattice is the whole safety argument. A contributor can only ever make this vocabulary stricter than the author shipped it, which is what makes it safe to resolve a vocabulary you did not write.
